prior_summary: A learned epsilon-predicting diffusion policy for the full expanded final red placement slice, augmented with explicit trainable red_at_goal and blue_at_goal predicate heads and weak post-success open/settle action losses.
applicable_conditions: Use when blue is already at or very near blue_goal and the robot is in the demonstrated transition that acquires or is carrying the red block from the buffer toward red_goal. The policy observes qpos/qvel, tcp_pose, red_pose, blue_pose, red_goal and blue_goal in world coordinates; no drawer or image input is used.
termination_guidance: The inference system may terminate or hand to a task monitor when current causal observations and the learned predicate cues indicate both red_at_goal and blue_at_goal. The completion contract itself is geometric containment of both blocks at their goals; release and retreat are only demonstrated context, not required task predicates.
limitations: The demonstrations are successful and provide mainly on-trajectory negatives before final placement, not adversarial boundary failures. The model does not implement IK, hard geometric constraints, image perception, or a scripted controller; all actions remain learned joint/gripper diffusion outputs.

representation.normalization: shared M1_v2 complete-demonstration normalizer supplied by assignment
